summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (Lahdo The bastiq/2)

data.turoyo: bәsәr ko… hawxa gә… gzolәn, i gәrrәkasse kfayšo bu arʕo.
data.translation: Then they become clear, their grounds stays in the bottom.

rationale: Thin Infectum/1 cell; juice as subject and explicitly remaining sediment clarify the process. Edition grammar and vowel spellings are preserved.

after: Beimischungen absetzen, sich durch Absetzen klären (intrans.);
rationale: Clarifies the fluid-subject/intransitive process supported by both verses; neither token supplies an agent removing an overt impurity object. The original settling meaning is retained.

summary: Both analysed forms are Infectum with fluid understood as subject. zolәn versus zayli is a source/dialect contrast, not independent evidence for another stem.
The grape-juice verse explicitly leaves the grounds at the bottom; the ayran edition describes water rising. These are compatible perspectives on separation, not proof of two lexical meanings.
Confirm zolәn relative to zayli and the status of the following qualifier zalile. Do not infer a new Part. Pass. box from that unanalysed qualifier alone.
94/197: collate the inherited German sediment-removal rendering with the supplied water-rising translation before making any fix-text correction.
The fluid may be grape juice or ayran; the common event is clarification/separation, without an expressed removal agent or direct object.
